call_points.text: FY27 volume growth guided at mid-single digits
₹275 Cr capex planned for FY27, 65-70% funded by internal accruals
Demand holding up well despite July rains, project sales to increase by 3-4%
No corporate guarantee on JV loan, balance sheet not under pressure
New 9+ million sqm greenfield plant in South with ₹350 Cr potential revenue
April 2026 saw slow demand due to Morbi shutdown, price increases, and dealer destocking; expects pent-up demand in June
Cannot do share buyback for next 6-8 months due to SEBI embargo on subsidiary consolidation

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: OIO Passed under Section 50, 50(1), 73(1), of the CGST/HGST Act, and section 20 of IGST Act issue pertains to alleged difference in Tax liability paid in GSTR-3B Vs Eway bills, ITC availed in GSTR3B vs ITC available as per E way Bills, Ineligible ITC availed for cancelled dealers and non-filers of 3B (Amount Rs. 17.74 Crores).

The writ petition has been filed challenging the Constitutional Validity of Haryana Tax on entry of goods in the Local Area Act, 2008, in the light of Law laid down by the nine judge bench in the Supreme Court (Amount Rs. 8.11 Crores)
tax_litigation.status: The pleadings have completed in this matter and next hearing is in May, 2026.

operating_notes.text: Somany Max plant achieved breakeven in Q4FY26, turning from a ₹9 Cr loss in Q4FY25
Morbi capacity utilization expected to reach 85% by end-May 2026, with 10-15% unlikely to restart
Total input cost increase of ₹6.5-7 per sq ft, with ₹5.5-6 from gas and ₹1-1.5 from other inputs
Capacity utilization increased to 83% from 72% YoY
JVs swung to ₹3 Cr profit from ₹10 Cr loss YoY
Working capital days reduced from 17 to 12 days
